name: What information should I prepare before contacting a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What information should I prepare before contacting a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a general contractor, it's beneficial to have a clear understanding of your project goals, a preliminary budget range, and any existing plans or designs. Gathering inspirational images or a detailed scope of work can significantly aid in communicating your vision. This preparation helps the contractor provide a more accurate estimate and allows for a more productive initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your project goals, a preliminary budget, and any existing plans or designs before contacting a general contractor to ensure a productive discussion.
